messages:
sophia: Heads-up — in compare view the cohort sample counts jump when quantize=true. Noticed after the runner deploy last night, looks like samples duplicate across buckets.
ajay: Hmm, can you paste repro steps and which scorecard / cohort? link? :eyes:
sophia: Repro steps:
1) open Console -> Scorecards -> Compare
2) select baseline + variant, set quantize=true in the URL
3) pick cohort = `signup_week=2026-03-01`
Observed: baseline shows 1.2k samples, variant shows 3.6k (should be ~1.2k). Link: https://internal.redwood/console/scorecards/compare?quantize=true&cohort=signup_week%3D2026-03-01
ajay: thanks — can you dump the runner-export payload for that run? a small sample would help.
sophia: pasted a trimmed export sample below (redacted):
```
{
  "variant_id": "v2-2026-03-05",
  "cohort": "signup_week=2026-03-01",
  "sample_count": 1200,
  "metrics": {...}
}
```
but the frontend aggregation is showing multiples of that row.
carter: quick guess: frontend aggregation key is wrong. I saw code using `groupBy(variant_id)` when building compare buckets instead of `cohort_id || cohort`. If runner exports are per-variant-per-cohort, grouping bug would duplicate counts across cohorts.
maria: I dug into the sparkline calc — heatmap percentiles call `total_samples` from the exporter but the exporter recently rolled up `total_samples` per variant (pre-quantize) and we didn't adapt the UI. So when quantize toggles we end up reusing variant totals for cohort-level charts.
dylan: fwiw CI job 3124 had e2e failures targeting compare view right after the export change — looks related.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: deploy to staging finished. job 3124 failed: https://ci.redwood/job/3124 (logs attached) :warning:
sophia: Workaround: toggle Query param `aggregate_by=cohort` (forces server-side cohort aggregation) — that fixes the counts in the UI for now.
ajay: I'll open a hotfix PR to force cohort aggregation for compare view until we fix grouping logic. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/2487 — will add an e2e that toggles quantize and asserts counts stable.
carter: I'll add a unit test in runner-exporter asserting `cohort_sample_count` exists for every exported cohort row, and update the frontend grouping to use `cohort || cohort_id`.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll follow up on metric naming in the scorecard so we don't accidentally read `total_samples` from the wrong rollup. Might need a small migration or schema bump.
sophia: thanks all — assigning follow-ups: ajay PR, carter exporter test + frontend fix, maria metric audit. Posting a screen shot in the tickets channel.
_meta: auto-generated slack thread for eng-ml about a compare-view cohort/sample-count mismatch after quantize/export changes
